verdict.rationale: Apple's Mac User Guide has a dedicated switcher section that teaches newcomers how to find their way around the Mac and transfer files from a PC. Setup Assistant and Migration Assistant help with initial setup, including when migrating from Windows. However, no evidence shows a guided tutorial for installing or reinstalling the OS itself, and the interface guidance is only a one-line pointer. Missing for 10: guided OS installation/reinstallation tutorial, evidence of in-depth step-by-step desktop interface tutorials, independent or hands-on corroboration of the switcher guidance.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can follow guided tutorials to install the OS and learn the desktop interface

citations.quote: If you’re switching to Mac, start here to make it a smooth transition. Learn how to find your way around the Mac, how to transfer your files from your PC, and more.
With Migration Assistant, setting up a new Mac is still quick and easy — even if you’re migrating from Windows.
Just bring your iPhone near your Mac, and Setup Assistant signs you in to your Wi-Fi network and Apple Account.
